deterministic_row_binding.exact_time: Numeric Time values must match exactly at t and t+1 within floating tolerance 1e-9; no interpolation or nearest-neighbor matching.
deterministic_row_binding.duplicate_subject_time: If more than one raw row has the same subject and same Time, that subject-time key is AMBIGUOUS and is excluded rather than averaged or arbitrarily selected.
deterministic_row_binding.reason: Preserves AMBIGUITY_IS_A_FIRST_CLASS_STATE and avoids constructing a synthetic joint PCR/culture state from separate rows.
deterministic_row_binding.finite_numeric: Blank, NA, NaN, inf and non-numeric values are missing.
deterministic_row_binding.nasal_detection_boundary: Nasal_CN >= 48 is excluded from the primary continuous-transition endpoint because 48 encodes PCR non-detection in the source analysis.
deterministic_row_binding.saliva_detection_boundary: Saliva_Ct >= 47 is excluded from the secondary continuous-transition endpoint because 47 encodes PCR non-detection in the source analysis.
deterministic_row_binding.culture_encoding: Virus_pos_days is used exactly as the source numeric assay-state variable, including 5.9 as the source's encoded negative-culture boundary; no binary recoding is used in the primary frozen model.
deterministic_row_binding.subject_filter: No filter by Index, Lineage, Age, Antigen, or clinical subgroup is permitted in C031.

model_binding.solver: numpy.linalg.lstsq ordinary least squares with intercept; no ridge penalty, no feature standardization, no hyperparameter tuning.
model_binding.metric: mean absolute error pooled over all held-out eligible transitions
model_binding.permutation: Globally permute culture values across eligible current transitions using deterministic Python random seed 31031 for each of 1000 sequential shuffles; subject labels, PCR variables, Time and outcomes remain fixed.
